name: Website Maintenance – PTI
author: PTI WebTech

sections.description:
Website Maintenance – PTI is a next-generation WordPress maintenance mode and coming soon suite. Whether you are performing routine maintenance, major theme migrations, or launching a brand-new website, this plugin gives you the ultimate combination of visual excellence and powerful site management.

Key Features:

✅ Modern Admin Dashboard – Intuitive, tabbed management interface built with high-end design tokens, quick status toggling, and instant feedback.
✅Stunning Frontend Templates – Handcrafted, mobile-first, and ultra-responsive:
1.Aurora Glass – Frosted glassmorphism card with ambient glow orbs and floating countdown units.
2.Minimal Elegance – Editorial agency aesthetic with brand hero, status badge, and direct contact buttons.
3.Cyber Pulse – Futuristic dark theme with neon blue accents, countdown cards, and deployment progress bar.
4.Creative Canvas – Fullscreen cinematic hero wallpaper with top navigation and bottom social bar.
✅Email Lead Capture / Subscribers – Capture visitor emails while in maintenance mode. Built-in subscriber manager with 1-click Export to CSV and optional admin email alerts.
✅Live Countdown & Progress Bar – Dynamic Days/Hours/Minutes/Seconds digit cards with automatic or manual progress bar tracking.
✅Auto-Disable on Zero – Automatically turn off maintenance mode and make your website live when the countdown hits zero.
✅Advanced Access Control & Whitelisting :
Role Whitelisting (choose which roles, e.g. Administrator, Editor, etc. can view live site).
IP Address Whitelisting (allow developers or clients to browse normally without logging in).
Secret Bypass Link (1-click copy with 24-hour cookie generation and instant token reset).
✅Scope Selection – Put the whole site or only specific target pages into maintenance mode.
✅SEO Safe & Mode Switcher – Choose between 503 Service Unavailable (for temporary maintenance) and 200 OK (for pre-launch Coming Soon pages).
✅Complete Branding Customization – Custom Logo uploader with width control, custom Favicon, background gradient presets, custom wallpaper upload, and color pickers.
✅Direct Contact & Social Profiles – Integrated buttons for Email, Phone, WhatsApp, and social media links (Facebook, X/Twitter, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, GitHub).
✅1-Click Live Preview – Test all templates directly in your browser without logging out or opening incognito tabs.
✅Custom Code Injection – Monospace code editors for custom CSS and JavaScript.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/website-maintenance-pti/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure the settings under Settings → Maintenance Mode in the WordPress admin panel.
  4. Enable maintenance mode and customize your message, countdown timer, and template as needed.
sections.faq:
How do I exclude specific pages from maintenance mode?

You can use the settings panel to select specific pages or apply the ptiwmm_selected_pages_filter filter in your code.

Will search engines index my maintenance page?

You can choose between HTTP 503 Service Unavailable (for temporary maintenance to protect SEO) or HTTP 200 OK (for Coming Soon pre-launch pages) in the settings.

Can administrators and specific roles still see the live site?

Yes, you can whitelist specific user roles (like Administrator, Editor, etc.) and even specific IP addresses, or use the 1-click Secret Bypass Link.

Can I capture subscriber emails during maintenance?

Yes, version 2.0.0 features built-in Email Lead Capture with an integrated subscriber manager and 1-click CSV export.

Can I customize CSS or JavaScript?

Yes, custom CSS and JavaScript editors are provided directly inside the admin settings panel.
sections.changelog:
2.0.0

  • Complete redesign of Admin Dashboard with modern UI, tabbed layout, quick status switch, and toast notifications.
  • Redesigned 4 modern, mobile-responsive frontend templates (Aurora Glass, Minimal Elegance, Cyber Pulse, Creative Canvas).
  • Added Email Lead Capture form with AJAX submission, subscriber management table, and CSV export.
  • Added Role Whitelisting and IP Whitelisting.
  • Added Auto-Disable on Countdown expiration.
  • Added 1-Click Live Preview mode for admins.
  • Added custom Logo, Favicon, Social links, and Direct Contact pills.
  • Improved asset isolation to prevent third-party plugins from breaking maintenance screen.
  • Maintained 100% backward compatibility with all previous settings and options.

1.0.3

  • Maintenance fixes and minor updates.
